title: Basalt bas-relief carrying hermetic teachings

tellings.quote: you is a giant Basalt what's called a b relief and it is this massive 3ot by 3ot by 4ot stone column uh block that has all these sacred teachings that literally became what I think is the basis of hermeticism itself

plain: In the Lake Van region of Turkey stands a large basalt block, about 3 by 3 by 4 feet, carved in relief with sacred teachings that a researcher named Matt LaCroix believes became the basis of Hermeticism, an old mystical and philosophical tradition. LaCroix describes the stone to Michels without naming a source. He presents it as a sign that ideas later known as Hermetic began in a much older culture.
